title: Coordination on a Budget: Federated Active Learning with Few Labels
abstract: arXiv:2608.18634v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated Active Learning (FAL) addresses the dual challenges of data privacy and label scarcity, where the absence of a global data view introduces additional hurdles for coordinated query selection. We study cross-silo FAL in the low-budget regime, where annotation decisions are most critical. We characterize, both theoretically and empirically, a heterogeneity reversal: in low-budget settings, homogeneous (IID) data requires stronger coordination to avoid redundant queries, whereas heterogeneous data naturally promotes diversity; this trend reverses at higher budgets. Thus, in contrast to the standard federated learning (FL) narrative where heterogeneity is a primary challenge, we show that IID settings are more challenging for query selection in FAL. translated_title: 预算有限下的协调：少标签的联邦主动学习
translated_abstract: 联邦主动学习（FAL）解决了数据隐私和标签稀缺的双重挑战，其中缺乏全局数据视图为协调查询选择带来了额外障碍。我们研究了低预算场景下的跨孤岛FAL，在此场景中，标注决策最为关键。我们在理论和实证上刻画了一种异质性反转：在低预算设置中，同质（IID）数据需要更强的协调以避免冗余查询，而异质数据则自然促进多样性；这种趋势在高预算时发生逆转。因此，与标准联邦学习（FL）中异质性作为主要挑战的叙事相反，我们表明在FAL中，IID设置对查询选择更具挑战性。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种新的FAL框架，利用联邦表示学习将客户端数据对齐到共享嵌入空间中，从而使服务器能够……
tldr: 该论文揭示了低预算联邦主动学习中同质数据比异质数据更需协调的异质性反转现象，并提出基于联邦表示学习的框架来优化查询选择。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a heterogeneity reversal in low-budget federated active learning, where homogeneous data requires more coordination than heterogeneous data, and proposes a federated representation learning framework to optimize query selection.
